rationale: 2y arithmetic expectations leg already absorbs most of a one-year +100bp stance shock; event-study target/path shocks and ACM TP regressions leave only a small same-direction TP residual. Low=0 reflects an expectations-only, no-uncertainty case.

High-frequency policy news moves distant real forwards/long yields more than pure expectations and the excess tends to mean-revert; after allowing a roughly one-year perceived policy-path half-life, the old 10y beta gap implies about +6bp TP. High covers rate-amplifying demand episodes without using event-day peaks as an annual scalar.

No official ACM/KW 30y response series is as directly usable as 10y; extrapolate from 30y event-study yield responses, long-forward term-premium evidence, and old beta closure. Duration-risk response is allowed to exceed 10y modestly, but remains transitory in the 12m dose.
Persistent-level expectations leg is already +100bp at 2y; residual TP channel is limited to uncertainty/liquidity premia. Low=0 avoids double-counting deterministic path shifts.

The persistent path itself is already in the expectations leg, so this row captures only risk-premium/uncertainty/supply repricing. 2023 higher-for-longer plus issuance/QT episodes show large positive 10y TP moves, but those are not pure policy-path elasticities; base is deliberately below episode ratios and high is a stress-tail.

Long-end term premium is more exposed to duration supply and inflation/rate uncertainty. Base is a modest persistent higher-for-longer residual; high covers 2023/QT-style long-duration supply stress. Low=0 remains valid for a clean deterministic path shift.
QT/supply evidence is concentrated at longer tenors; any 2y addon should usually be zero.
Active-QT announcement effects raise 10y yields by several bp after forward-guidance controls; 2023 issuance/QT evidence supports a positive but not mechanically large addon.
QT/duration-supply channel steepens and is most relevant at long maturities; apply only when the scenario explicitly includes active QT or duration-supply surprise.
